articles.summary: NB Bancorp, Inc. (the "Company") (Nasdaq Capital Market: NBBK), the holding company of Needham Bank (the "Bank"), today announced its third quarter 2026 financial results. SELECTED FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS FOR THE THIRD QUARTER OF 2026 Net income for the third quarter of 2026 amounted to $23.1 million, or $0.58 per diluted common share, compared to net income of $21.1 million, or $0.53 per diluted common share, for the prior quarter. Return on average assets and return on average equity for the third quarter of 2026 were 1.23% and 10.73%, respectively, representing increases from 1.17% and 10.03%, respectively, for the prior quarter. Operating net income (1) for the third quarter of 2026 increased 8.9% and amounted to $23.8 million, or $0.60 per diluted common share, compared to operating net income (1) of $21.9 million, or $0.55 per diluted common share, for the prior quarter. articles.title: NB Bancorp, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results, Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
